text:
Alex Romero: quick sync after the last two incidents. pattern: big ramp + no enforced abort -> broad impact. want a minimal set of controls we can ship this week.
Priya Nair: totally. propose two small primitives: a strict early-abort rule (error spike window) and a per-flag concurrent user cap. low-risk to add.
Diego Morales: I'll take early-abort. idea: evaluate 3 metrics over a 2-5m sliding window, trigger abort if any cross threshold. thresholds: error_rate > 2.5%, p95 latency increase > 40%, or tail cpu > 85%.
Lina Chen: I'll own per-flag caps and enforcement hooks in the feature-flag service. cap should be settable by route and by environment. default conservative caps for prod.
Alex Romero: good. let's keep defaults aggressive to reduce blast radius: default initial_pct 3%, ramp 15m, max 15%. Anything above must be explicit and signed off.
Priya Nair: add a safety escalation: if abort triggers, we immediately open a handoff to oncall and create an "auto-abort" incident with trace links. also add a tagging field on flags that have aborted historically.
Diego Morales: implementation plan: 1) rollout-config schema + enforcement hooks (my PR) 2) integration tests using synthetic traffic harness 3) telemetry: abort events exported to control plane. ETA: PR by Mon 2026-03-30.
Lina Chen: my plan: middleware in flagging service + metric exports + admin UI cap controls. ETA: Weds 2026-04-01.
Priya Nair: I'll update the runbook and add the abort incident template. ETA: Thurs 2026-04-02.
Alex Romero: I'll coordinate the release gating and add the action items to the postmortem tracker. please add links to PRs here when opened.
ops-bot: checklist: infra-ticket created -> https://redwood.internal/INF-4923, oncall notify hook added.
Diego Morales: opened branch feat/auto-abort-173, adding unit tests now. will include the 3-metric window config.
Lina Chen: pairing available Thu AM for tests. also adding a dashboard tile for per-flag active users.
Priya Nair: can we also add a quarterly report that surfaces flags with >1 abort in 90 days? I'll make INF ticket after this sync.
Alex Romero: yes, make a ticket and assign to Product Ops.
Diego Morales: note: I'll include a replay test using the last incident traffic (sanitized) to validate thresholds.
Lina Chen: once deployed, we should run a small canary of the control (enable caps on a couple low-risk routes) and monitor for false positives.
Alex Romero: agreed. final action list for tracker: 1) Diego - auto-abort schema + PR + synth tests (due 2026-03-30) 2) Lina - flag cap middleware + metrics + dashboard (due 2026-04-01) 3) Priya - runbook + incident template + quarterly-report ticket (due 2026-04-02) 4) Alex - tracker updates + small release coordination (due 2026-03-29).
Priya Nair: ack. I'll draft runbook changes and post link here when ready.
Diego Morales: PR link: https://git.redwood/infer/rollouts/pull/421 (WIP).
Lina Chen: adding dashboard mock to the PR later today.
Alex Romero: thanks everyone. short check-in Fri at 10 to confirm PRs and test status. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: thanks, see you Fri.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: short-sync Fri 10:00 -> calendar invite sent.
